translations.synopsis: Foundations of Real-World Economics: What Every Economics Student Needs to Know is a 2023 book by John Komlos in which the author argues that the turbulence of the 21st century, including the dot-com bubble, the 2008 financial crisis, the rise of right-wing populism, COVID-19 pandemic, and the Russo-Ukrainian War, cannot be adequately understood with conventional 20th-century economic thinking.
translations.title: Foundations of Real-World Economics
